Question Choices: Select. A sandwich is cut into 2 equal parts. Each part is called a: ~~half | third | fourth~~
Solution: Two equal parts make the whole sandwich. Each part is one half. Select half.

Question Choices: A rectangle is divided into 3 equal parts. Each part is called a __ (half, third, fourth).
Solution: Three equal parts make one whole rectangle. Each part is a third.

Question Choices: Fill: A circle is divided into 4 equal parts. It is divided into __ equal parts. Each part is called a __ (half, third, fourth).
Solution: There are four equal parts. Each is one fourth of the circle. Fill 4, fourth.

Question Choices: Select. Mia has a pizza. She cuts it into 4 equal slices. She eats 1 slice. What portion of the pizza did Mia eat?: ~~half | third | fourth | whole~~
Solution: One of four equal pizza slices is one fourth of the pizza. Select fourth.
